docs.summary: Wraps an existing native texture. No validation, no Core counterpart.
docs.remarks: Handle format depends on backend. Vulkan wants a valid VkImage. Description must match reality.

members.name: CreateTexture
members.signature: public virtual Texture CreateTexture(ulong nativeTexture, in TextureDescription description, TextureState restingState)

docs.summary: Wraps a native texture owned and synchronized elsewhere, such as an OpenXR swapchain image. Graphite leaves its contents alone when wrapping, expects it in `restingState` whenever Graphite uses it and returns it there afterwards, and never frees it. Vulkan wants a valid VkImage. Description must match reality.

params.restingState: The state it is in between uses, such as Attachment for an OpenXR colour swapchain image.
